answer_1.quote: In this work we presented DIBIMT, a novel benchmark for measuring and understanding semantic biases in NMT ... we test a wide range of models, both commercial and non-commercial ones, and report their performances on DIBIMT's evaluation metrics

answer_2.quote: We define four novel metrics that better clarify the semantic biases within MT models ... We report accuracy for non-MISS analyzed items (i.e., #GOOD+#BAD)

answer_4.quote: we sample a BAD translation (t_BAD ), pair it with a GOOD translation (t_GOOD ) produced by another model ... and ask annotators to check their correctness and apply corrections where needed
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to verify the correctness of each translation and to make grammatical corrections if necessary
